# Anthropic Shares Plunge Below IPO Price in Fourth Trading Day

By Carmen Reinicke and Anthony Hughes

November 24, 2026 at 6:19 AM EST

Updated on 

November 24, 2026 at 1:26 PM EST

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Anthropic PBC shares sank as much as nearly 9% below their $83 initial public offering price, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut last week.

The stock pared its earlier drop to 2.4%, trading at $81.04 each as of 1:18 p.m. in New York on Tuesday amid a broader pullback in equity markets, which had soared to begin the week. Anthropic first broke the IPO price in pre-market trading, dropping as low as $81.28.
